coverage_explanation: Tests the specified floor mapping at endpoints, near-endpoint quantization boundaries, exact one-third points, and the midpoint. Alternating increases and decreases plus repeated returns exercise updates rather than startup alone. Each changed input is checked at the specified 50 ms response deadline, with additional stable-state checks. Coverage is finite host-API coverage, not exhaustive testing of every ADC value.
assumptions: A0 receives raw ADC values from 0 through 1023; this uses the disclosed analog-input bench default and does not assume a particular potentiometer resistance.
The authoritative TM1637 connections are CLK=D4 and DIO=D5.
Leading blanks or zeros are accepted through numeric display comparisons.
No brightness level is specified; any enabled brightness is permitted. Display checks observe TM1637 API frames rather than physical optical brightness.
